oil.when: 2012–2013 with the maintenance settings in the gauge display and the SET switch you pull toward you
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Pull the SET switch toward you and hold it for more than 2 seconds until the selection screen appears.
Use the up and down switches to show Maintenance, then pull the SET switch. Select Engine Oil the same way.
Set the month, day, year and distance for the next oil change, pulling the SET switch after each one.
Select Set and pull the SET switch. The display confirms the setting for about 3 seconds.
oil.note: Checked in the 2012 and 2013 owner's manuals. Choosing the dashes instead of a number for any item turns that reminder off.

tpms.when: 2012–2013 (U.S. models; no driver reset, the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive at 20 mph or more. The system does not re-check the pressures until the car is moving at that speed.
If all tires are now properly inflated, the light should go out a few minutes later. There is no reset button.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2012 and 2013 owner's manuals. If the light blinks for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that no reset will clear; have a Subaru dealer check it. The same happens with the spare fitted or a wheel without its sensor.
